{"people":[{"name":"Renee","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Owen","role":"VP of Product, champion who reached out","side":"customer"},{"name":"Diane","role":"CFO, froze all new vendor projects","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"Engineering lead","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"Engineers on Owen's team","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed","role":"Former employee who built the homegrown billing system","side":"other"}],
"competitors":[],
"incumbent":"Homegrown billing system built by a former employee (status quo / doing nothing)",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"There wasn't one big thing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Rep says there was no trigger after hesitating ('Um. Good question.')."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"Their VP of Product, Owen, had wanted to rebuild billing for a while.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Long-standing desire from the champion; no event or deadline."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"The billing system is homegrown, built by a guy who left, and every pricing change takes them a quarter.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger","gaps"],"note":"Incumbent is homegrown. The pain is concrete: a quarter per pricing change."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"He reached out to us.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"The deal was inbound and started by Owen."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"He wanted it done before they launched a new pricing tier, but the tier didn't have a date either.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"A soft trigger with no deadline, so there was no forcing urgency."},
{"id":"E6","turn":6,"excerpt":"The CFO, I guess? Diane.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Rep is unsure who decided."},
{"id":"E7","turn":6,"excerpt":"They missed their number in Q3 and she put a hold on all new vendor projects.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"The freeze came from a missed Q3 number and covered all vendor projects."},
{"id":"E8","turn":6,"excerpt":"So I don't know that you'd say she decided against us. She decided against everything.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Rep frames the loss as a blanket freeze rather than a rejection of us."},
{"id":"E9","turn":8,"excerpt":"Owen told me. I never spoke to her.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The decider was never engaged directly. Everything about her is secondhand."},
{"id":"E10","turn":10,"excerpt":"No. Owen said he'd bring her in at the end.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The CFO was in no meeting. Her involvement was deferred to the end."},
{"id":"E11","turn":12,"excerpt":"There wasn't one. It was us against doing nothing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"The competitor was the status quo."},
{"id":"E12","turn":12,"excerpt":"Owen never looked at anybody else, as far as I know.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Hedged; no other vendor is known."},
{"id":"E13","turn":14,"excerpt":"Toward the end Owen started asking for things for finance.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["decided","gaps"],"note":"The customer's questions shifted toward finance, an early warning sign."},
{"id":"E14","turn":14,"excerpt":"do you have something that shows payback?","label":"fact","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Introduced with 'Like,' so it may be approximate. The customer wanted payback evidence."},
{"id":"E15","turn":14,"excerpt":"That started maybe a month before the freeze.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Estimated timing: the finance signal came about a month before the freeze."},
{"id":"E16","turn":16,"excerpt":"Reaction: the billing demo. Changing a price in a few clicks, trials, proration.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"The demo of price changes landed."},
{"id":"E17","turn":16,"excerpt":"that's a quarter of roadmap in five minutes.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"The customer frames value as roadmap time recovered."},
{"id":"E18","turn":16,"excerpt":"His engineers were into it.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Rep's read of engineering enthusiasm."},
{"id":"E19","turn":16,"excerpt":"I don't know that anything got silence.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Initial 'nothing' answer, later contradicted."},
{"id":"E20","turn":16,"excerpt":"We only ever talked to product and engineering.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decider"],"note":"Finance was never engaged."},
{"id":"E21","turn":16,"excerpt":"I said something about growing revenue","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Our pitch used revenue-growth framing."},
{"id":"E22","turn":16,"excerpt":"we're not trying to grow revenue with billing, we're trying to stop it being a tax on the roadmap.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"The customer explicitly rejected our revenue framing."},
{"id":"E23","turn":18,"excerpt":"The freeze email.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Rep's 'first felt' moment is the freeze email itself."},
{"id":"E24","turn":18,"excerpt":"Before that we were in procurement. Well, we'd sent paper.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided","outcome"],"note":"Self-correction: the deal was less advanced than first claimed."},
{"id":"E25","turn":20,"excerpt":"I sent him the ROI deck. The general one, with the study.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","message"],"note":"A generic ROI deck answered a request for a specific payback number."},
{"id":"E26","turn":20,"excerpt":"I can't get this past Diane without a number that's ours.","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider","language"],"note":"The champion said the generic ROI was insufficient for the CFO."},
{"id":"E27","turn":20,"excerpt":"We were going to set up a session to build one. Then Q3 closed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decided"],"note":"The business case was never built before the freeze."},
{"id":"E28","turn":22,"excerpt":"About a month.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"There was about a month between the payback request and the freeze, with no number delivered."},
{"id":"E29","turn":24,"excerpt":"The number. Their own. What the homegrown system costs them.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The primary gap was a customer-specific cost of the status quo."},
{"id":"E30","turn":24,"excerpt":"some landlord subscriptions lapse because the card fails and nobody chases it. We never added it up.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"A quantifiable revenue leak was mentioned but never sized."},
{"id":"E31","turn":24,"excerpt":"Moving the existing subscriptions over without asking landlords for their card details again, and whether they could do it in stages.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":true,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Migration concerns: card re-collection and a phased rollout."},
{"id":"E32","turn":24,"excerpt":"we don't touch billing before renewal season.","label":"quote","speaker":"Engineering lead (customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Timing constraint and risk aversion around billing changes."},
{"id":"E33","turn":24,"excerpt":"We had a doc for that. He wanted to talk to someone who'd done it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"A reference customer was wanted. The doc was insufficient, and no reference was mentioned as provided."},
{"id":"E34","turn":26,"excerpt":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded.","label":"quote","speaker":"Diane (CFO), relayed via Owen","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"CFO funding bar, heard thirdhand."},
{"id":"E35","turn":26,"excerpt":"nice to have","label":"quote","speaker":"Owen (VP of Product), describing finance's view","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","decider"],"note":"Finance classified the project as non-urgent."},
{"id":"E36","turn":28,"excerpt":"For Owen, yeah. For Diane, no.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"The urgency gap between champion and decider."},
{"id":"E37","turn":28,"excerpt":"I don't think anyone told her what it was costing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","decider"],"note":"Rep concedes the cost case never reached the CFO."},
{"id":"E38","turn":30,"excerpt":"It's timing. It'll come back next year.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome"],"note":"Rep attributes the outcome to timing and predicts a return; unsupported."},
{"id":"E39","turn":30,"excerpt":"I don't think there was anything we could have done.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","gaps"],"note":"Conflicts with the gaps the rep described."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E39","E26","E27","E29","E30","E33","E37"],"what":"Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a month-long unmet request for a customer-specific payback number, an unsized revenue leak, an unmet reference request, and admits no one told the CFO the cost."},
{"evidence":["E38","E34","E35","E37"],"what":"Rep blames timing, but the customer's words say the project was not seen as urgent ('nice to have', 'isn't on fire') because the cost case never reached finance."},
{"evidence":["E19","E21","E22"],"what":"Rep says nothing got silence, then describes the revenue framing being explicitly rejected."},
{"evidence":["E1","E3","E5"],"what":"Rep says there was no trigger, then describes a quarter-long cost per pricing change and a planned new pricing tier."},
{"evidence":["E24"],"what":"Rep claims the deal was in procurement, then corrects to only having sent paper."},
{"evidence":["E6","E8","E9","E10"],"what":"Rep names Diane as decider with uncertainty, says she didn't decide against us, and admits she was never met or engaged."},
{"evidence":["E23","E14","E26","E28"],"what":"Rep says the first sign was the freeze email, but the customer's shift to finance and payback questions came about a month earlier."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What happened at the customer that started this evaluation?","turn":2,"what":"Hesitated ('Um. Good question.'), said there was no single trigger, then described concrete pain and a planned pricing tier."},
{"question":"Who made the final call, and how do you know?","turn":6,"what":"Answered 'I guess?' and reframed the decision as a blanket freeze. Knowledge was entirely secondhand via Owen."},
{"question":"Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?","turn":16,"what":"First said nothing got silence, then admitted the revenue framing was rejected."},
{"question":"When did you first feel this wasn't going to close? What happened right before?","turn":18,"what":"Pointed to the freeze email and skipped the earlier payback request until pressed in T19."},
{"question":"Anything else?","turn":30,"what":"Closed with 'It's timing' and 'nothing we could have done', deflecting from the gaps already described."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"stop it being a tax on the roadmap / a quarter of roadmap in five minutes","ours":"growing revenue","evidence":["E17","E21","E22"]},
{"theirs":"a number that's ours / something that shows payback","ours":"the ROI deck. The general one, with the study","evidence":["E14","E25","E26"]},
{"theirs":"if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded / nice to have","ours":"It's timing","evidence":["E34","E35","E38"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E7","E8","E23"],"what":"No decision: the CFO froze all new vendor projects after a missed Q3 number, and the deal stopped at the freeze email."},
{"evidence":["E24","E27"],"what":"Paper had been sent, but the payback session was never held. The deal stalled before procurement."},
{"evidence":["E11","E12"],"what":"There was no competitor. The loss was to the status quo (the homegrown system)."},
{"evidence":["E38"],"what":"Rep predicts the deal returns next year (opinion, unsupported)."},
{"evidence":["E20","E36"],"what":"Product and engineering bought in, but finance never did. No part of the business moved."}
]}

contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could have been done, yet describes a month-long unmet request for a customer-specific payback number, an unsized revenue leak, an unmet reference request, and admits no one told the CFO the cost.
Rep blames timing, but the customer's words say the project was not seen as urgent ('nice to have', 'isn't on fire') because the cost case never reached finance.
Rep says nothing got silence, then describes the revenue framing being explicitly rejected.
Rep says there was no trigger, then describes a quarter-long cost per pricing change and a planned new pricing tier.
Rep claims the deal was in procurement, then corrects to only having sent paper.
Rep names Diane as decider with uncertainty, says she didn't decide against us, and admits she was never met or engaged.
Rep says the first sign was the freeze email, but the customer's shift to finance and payback questions came about a month earlier.

dodges.question: What happened at the customer that started this evaluation?
dodges.what: Hesitated ('Um. Good question.'), said there was no single trigger, then described concrete pain and a planned pricing tier.

dodges.question: Who made the final call, and how do you know?
dodges.what: Answered 'I guess?' and reframed the decision as a blanket freeze. Knowledge was entirely secondhand via Owen.

dodges.question: Which part of our pitch got a reaction, and which got silence?
dodges.what: First said nothing got silence, then admitted the revenue framing was rejected.

dodges.question: When did you first feel this wasn't going to close? What happened right before?
dodges.what: Pointed to the freeze email and skipped the earlier payback request until pressed in T19.

dodges.question: Anything else?
dodges.what: Closed with 'It's timing' and 'nothing we could have done', deflecting from the gaps already described.

language_pairs.theirs: stop it being a tax on the roadmap / a quarter of roadmap in five minutes
a number that's ours / something that shows payback

language_pairs.theirs: if it isn't on fire, it isn't funded / nice to have

outcome_signals.what: No decision: the CFO froze all new vendor projects after a missed Q3 number, and the deal stopped at the freeze email.
Paper had been sent, but the payback session was never held. The deal stalled before procurement.
There was no competitor. The loss was to the status quo (the homegrown system).
Rep predicts the deal returns next year (opinion, unsupported).
Product and engineering bought in, but finance never did. No part of the business moved.
